title: Compose Task completion in the PWA

gates.name: task_completion_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/task-completion.spec.ts

verify: Independent completion verification covers exact existing-Task command, success/duplicate/conflict/permission/archive behavior, authoritative reread, and absence of arbitrary Task/device paths.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-027 RED: no browser Task-completion consumer exists; GREEN: exact authorized completion advances only the selected eligible Task while duplicate/conflict/permission/archive cases remain truthful and no arbitrary Task/device request exists; decisive comparison: request allowlist, response/DOM, and authoritative Task reread; artifact: completion evidence under .tasks/TASK-105-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose existing-Task completion independently of reads, Safety approval, and follow-up Outcome recording.
success_outcome: An authorized Boss/Engineer can complete only an eligible existing Task while denied/conflict/archive paths remain non-mutating and no arbitrary work or device capability is introduced.
anti_goals: Do not implement lists, Safety approval, Outcome recording, arbitrary Task creation, editable task text, or device commands.
Do not derive task kind, scope, attribution, or lifecycle in the PWA.

forbidden_scope: arbitrary Task creation or editable kind/text
stop_conditions: Completion requires a command outside Task And Approval HTTP.
The PWA would need to create work, infer eligibility, or execute a device.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Task & Follow-Up owns Task identity, eligibility, transition, and audit.
Submit only the exact completion body and trust backend results.
invariants: Completion creates no device execution or arbitrary Task authority.
Denied/conflict/archive/duplicate handling preserves authoritative Task state.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-027: exact completion, duplicate/conflict/permission/archive behavior, authoritative reread, and no arbitrary Task/device path.
T3 harm proof uses isolated Tasks and confirms safe rerun/denial leaves no unintended transition or device effect.
